author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: A 2002 study examined 12 artificial reefs built off Miami Beach using limestone boulders, concrete-gravel aggregate and concrete mixed with waste tyre chips. The researchers found no significant difference in fish abundance, biomass or species richness between the three reef materials. author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Dale Sanders, a 91-year-old Tennessee man known as “Grey Beard”, has reclaimed his record as the oldest hiker to complete the Appalachian Trail. Sanders finished the gruelling 2,193-mile trek despite falling 71 times, including six hard falls, suffering injuries and briefly being hospitalised during his extraordinary journey across 14 states.
title: At 91, 'Grey Beard' reclaims record as oldest to complete 2,193-mile Appalachian Trail

author: TAMAGHNA BANERJEE
description: This year, Kolkata's iconic Janmashtami celebration has taken a significant turn, becoming an event solely for Hindus. Previously open to participation from Muslims, this change aims to emphasize Hindu traditions and cultural heritage. As a result, the event will now be organized exclusively by Hindu community members, marking a notable shift from decades of inclusive celebrations that reflect the city's rich multicultural identity.
title: Started by a Muslim, a Kolkata Janmashtami turns ‘Hindu-only’

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Stan Kroenke is expanding his already impressive sports empire by acquiring the Los Angeles Angels. This high-stakes deal will mark the entry of Major League Baseball into his extensive collection of teams. With a staggering net worth of $24.3 billion, largely derived from real estate ventures, Kroenke's franchises have enjoyed remarkable championship success in recent years. The deal is anticipated to be completed by early 2027.
title: Stan Kroenke net worth 2026: How did the Rams owner build his $24.3 billion empire?

author: ARVIND CHAUHAN
description: After careful consideration, the search committee has identified three potential candidates for the CEO position. Each candidate, originating from Uttar Pradesh, carries a unique blend of experience relevant to the role. In an upcoming meeting, the Trust will determine who will take on management responsibilities for administrative operations and pilgrim facilities, with an official announcement on their selection expected in the near future.
title: ​Ram Temple CEO race narrows to three candidates, all from UP

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: The Smithsonian Board of Regents has officially selected the Arts and Industries Building as the site for the National Museum of the American Latino, concluding a prolonged discussion regarding its permanent home on the National Mall. Once renovated and modernized, this historic structure, which dates back to 1881, will eliminate the need for congressional approval for a new venue. Notably, the museum's first preview space already opened in 2022.
title: Smithsonian's 1881 building, closed in 2004, gets new life after $55m restoration

title: ‘Every rescue now a miracle’: 4,462 still missing in Nepal, hopes dim
